messages:
maria_garcia: Quick async check — starting a 10% canary for slice 'us-west-low-latency' using ff:slice-usw. Started at 17:00 UTC. I ran the basic smoke tests and validated autoscale triggers.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary started for service=inference-runtime slice=us-west-low-latency percent=10 commit=6f3a2c4 — dashboards: https://grafana/redwood/c/anomaly?slice=us-west-low-latency

alex_cheng: +1 on the start. Small heads-up: I pushed a fallback tweak in the rollout controller yesterday — it should prefer model-quantized-v2 as the fallback, not the CPU variant. Patch: `rollout.config.fallback = "model-quantized-v2"`

jon_s: Can we confirm the fallback path will be used automatically when we see node OOMs or only on request failure codes? Need clarity to set alert thresholds.

lisa_ops: It only triggers on 5xx from the runtime + k8s OOMKilled pod events (current config). I think we should add a short-circuit for sustained queuing (>2s) too. Proposed rollback/trip criteria I suggest: p95 latency > 250ms OR error_rate_5m > 0.5% OR queue_depth_avg > 100 for 5m.

maria_garcia: Agree on the criteria. @kevin_t can you ack that ops will add queue-based short-circuit? Also want to confirm Dedicated customers won't be auto-swapped unless feature flag allowed.

kevin_t: Ack — I'll add queue_shortcircuit:true for hosted by default, and ensure dedicated clusters have `allow_auto_fallback:false` unless explicitly enabled per-account. Will PR in ~30m.

alex_cheng: Quick verification step for reviewers: run `kubectl logs -n inference rollout-controller | grep fallback` — you should see the new fallback selection at start. Example log: `fallback chosen=model-quantized-v2 reason=memory-pressure`

jon_s: Thx. I'll stub an alert runbook in ops-runbooks for this slice and add the p95 / error thresholds. Tagging oncall in case we need immediate rollback.

lisa_ops: One more thing — canary traffic is going to both replicas in us-west zone A/B. If zone A shows any systemic 5xx we should automatically cut traffic from that zone and keep overall canary at 10% but split to zone B only. Ops will script that.

maria_garcia: Perfect. My blockers: waiting on kevin's PR and a +1 from eng-sre on the rollback criteria. Today: monitoring for next 2h and will post a short postmortem if anything odd. Please ping here if you see spike graphs. :eyes:

kevin_t: PR opened: https://git.internal/p/r/234 — includes config and a small test harness. @alex_cheng can you glance?

alex_cheng: Reviewing now. If all green I can approve in 10-15m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy: canary healthcheck passed initial 5m probe for 3/3 pods.

maria_garcia: thanks team. If no issues I'll start ramp plan at +5% after 2h if metrics stable. Otherwise hold and investigate.

jon_s: I'll keep an eye on synthetic checks and circle back with a short summary at +30m.

lisa_ops: Standby on rollback script, will post link when done.

kevin_t: ack — will set the dedicated guardrails too.
